<div class="card-body">
'''Reegesk''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">リージェスク</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">毎ターン、自分の支配フェイズに、1度だけ、1フォース消費して敵のロスト・デッキか「墜落記念碑」をあさり、ビークル、ドロイド、武器、アイテムのいずれかを1枚、自分の手札にいれて、自分のカードとして使用できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Reegesk-PSA-93071762.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">アラリア出身のラナットの盗賊にして廃品あさり。ジャワとの取引が多い。持ち主が気付かぬうちに品物を盗む。ガラクタだろうがなんだろうが、どんなものでも盗みたがる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Reegesk.

'''Card text:'''
Once each turn during your control phase, spend 1 Force to rummage the opponent's Lost Pile or Crash Site Memorial. Take one vehicle, droid, weapon, or device into hand and use it as your own.

'''Lore:'''
A Ranat thief and scavenger from Aralia. He often trades with Jawas. He steals goods before the owner notices. He wants to steal anything, even junk.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese spends 1 Force; English loses 1 Force.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Reegesk]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
